{"path":"cluster_cities.py","content":"import csv
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

SRC = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
OUT_ROWS = "outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv"
OUT_PROFILES = "outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv"

ID_COLS = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]

df = pd.read_csv(SRC)

# numeric indicator columns = everything that is not an identifier column
num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ID_COLS]
assert num_cols, "no numeric indicators found"
# make sure all indicator columns are numeric
for c in num_cols:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

print("rows:", len(df), "indicators:", num_cols)
print("missing per indicator:\n", df[num_cols].isna().sum())

X = df[num_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)

pipe = Pipeline([
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("kmeans", KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)),
])
labels = pipe.fit_predict(X)

out = df[ID_COLS].copy()
out["cluster_id"] = labels.astype(int)

# cluster profiles: mean of the RAW indicator values (pre-imputation / pre-scaling),
# computed over non-missing values only
prof = df.groupby(labels)[num_cols].mean()  # pandas mean skips NaN by default
prof = prof.reindex(sorted(prof.index))
prof.insert(0, "cluster_id", prof.index.astype(int))
print(prof.to_string())
print("cluster sizes:", pd.Series(labels).value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())


def dump(path, frame):
    """Write an RFC 4180 CSV: quote fields containing comma, quote or newline."""
    cols = list(frame.columns)
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\n")
        w.writerow(cols)
        for row in frame.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            w.writerow(["" if (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v)) else v for v in row])


dump(OUT_ROWS, out)
dump(OUT_PROFILES, prof)
print("written", OUT_ROWS, OUT_PROFILES)
"}

SRC = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"

OUT_PROFILES = "outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv"

# numeric indicator columns = everything that is not an identifier column
num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ID_COLS]
assert num_cols, "no numeric indicators found"
# make sure all indicator columns are numeric
for c in num_cols:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

print("rows:", len(df), "indicators:", num_cols)
print("missing per indicator:\n", df[num_cols].isna().sum())

X = df[num_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)

pipe = Pipeline([
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("kmeans", KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)),
])
labels = pipe.fit_predict(X)

out = df[ID_COLS].copy()
out["cluster_id"] = labels.astype(int)

# cluster profiles: mean of the RAW indicator values (pre-imputation / pre-scaling),
# computed over non-missing values only
prof = df.groupby(labels)[num_cols].mean()  # pandas mean skips NaN by default
prof = prof.reindex(sorted(prof.index))
prof.insert(0, "cluster_id", prof.index.astype(int))
print(prof.to_string())
print("cluster sizes:", pd.Series(labels).value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())


def dump(path, frame):
    """Write an RFC 4180 CSV: quote fields containing comma, quote or newline."""
    cols = list(frame.columns)
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\n")
        w.writerow(cols)
        for row in frame.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            w.writerow(["" if (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v)) else v for v in row])
